title: WhyJan's Timer Datapack
body:
This custom datapack displays a very simple timer/stopwatch directly above your hotbar.

![What the timer looks like (mode 1)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22c1dc83a4d27e80311573e59c588a0823da5743.png)

## Features
- doesn't require OP to be used (good for servers)
- easy to use
- simple, minimal look
- lag/vanilla friendly

## How to use
```
/trigger <command>
```


**Possible actions:**
- _StartTimer_ -> Starts the timer at 0h 0m 0s
- _PauseTimer_ -> Pauses the timer (does not reset the time)
- _ResumeTimer_ -> Resumes the timer at the time before the pause
- _EndTimer_ -> Prints out a message in chat with the final time + resets the timer to 0h 0m 0s
- _ResetTimer_ -> resets the timer to 0h 0m 0s
- _ToggleMode_ -> Toggles the timer between the two time formats: -h -m -s  /  hh:mm:ss


## Installation
Move the .zip file into the following directory:

  _../worldname/datapacks/_

or drag and drop it onto the screen while creating a new world.
